cues: A topology is the shape of a network.
Bus: every computer taps one backbone cable; cheap, but one break stops everything.
Star: everything connects to a central switch; a cable fault affects one computer, but the switch is a single point of failure.
Ring: data passes round in one direction; equal access, but one break stops the ring.
Mesh: every pair is linked; the most reliable and the most expensive.
Tree: stars arranged in a hierarchy.
